findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Eval or exec usage in typing_inspection
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-direct
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of eval, exec, or compile which can execute arbitrary code if fed untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: The typing introspection library might use eval or exec for dynamic type evaluation

message.text: Use of eval, exec, or compile which can execute arbitrary code if fed untrusted input.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous code execution functions
 * @description Finding usage of exec, compile, or other dangerous execution functions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/dangerous-exec-functions
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "Popen", "check_output"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous code execution or deserialization function"
findings.hypothesis: Check for other dangerous execution functions beyond eval
